title: Guerrilla 450 Roadster (Sport Black)
description: The Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450 Roadster (Sport Black) is tailored for aggressive twisties and sharp canyon transitions, positioned in the Middleweight Sportbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 450cc engine generating 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 163 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
